svg.title: UTILITIES / CIVIL GALLERY NETWORK
svg.text: Connected under-road passages / 81 capped branch takeoffs / nine open stair-access hubs
CITY-LOCAL NW ORIGIN | +X EAST | +Z SOUTH | CIVIL Y0 = FUTURE WALKABLE SURFACE S
ALL BOUNDS INCLUSIVE / NO WORLD ANCHOR OR SURVEYED Y / CIVIL DESIGN, NOT GAME-TESTED
Under every street: outer offsets 2..9, with 6 blocks clear at offsets
3..8. Floor Y-10; five-block interior Y-9..-5; roof Y-4. All levels relative
Offsets 5..6 reserve a two-wide walk. Offsets 3..4 reserve fluids; 7..8
reserve electrical/ item services. No pipes, cable tiers, capacities or
Tile-relative X50..57, Z9..18. The branch ends before the hall. Future
building design supplies its elevation transition and real hatches/
Nine hubs in tiles i,j = 1,4,7. Each sits in the west parcel margin and
connects by a spur to the nearest V street. Three-wide half-step
Lighting sockets are a separate reservation CSV. Fixtures and full
gallery/ road spawn coverage require testing before use.
